To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the IMD and CMD methods deliver the optimal designs of the structural members made of the isotropic and the cubic materials, respectively; the optimal designs can be recovered from the optimal values of the bulk and the invariant moduli; the underlying microstructures corresponding to the optimal values of moduli can be recovered from these optimal moduli.

the IMD and CMD methods deliver the optimal material designs which are not only manufacturable, but also recoverable.
the IMD method can be applied to the optimal designs of the structural components made of the materials of cubic symmetry.
